t: 玛雅国王Yuknoom Yich'aak K'ahk出任卡拉克穆尔的王冠.
te: Maya king Yuknoom Yich'aak K'ahk' assumes the crown of Calakmul.
dz: 玛雅国王Yuknoom Yich'aak K'ahk出任卡拉克穆尔的王冠.
de: Maya king Yuknoom Yich'aak K'ahk' assumes the crown of Calakmul.
